promotion_statement: Promotes exactly SW-022/SW-133; SW-137 held (candidate guard, ambiguous same-minute adjacency)
note: One explicit row per pending ID. Promotes exactly SW-022/SW-133; SW-137 held (candidate guard, ambiguous same-minute adjacency) (semantically exact structural definitions). Baselines are internal operational targets (red-flag rate ideal = 0), NOT industry benchmarks. Missing is never zero.

specs.title: Rep logs <3 outbound calls/day for 2 consecutive days
specs.population: sales reps expected to make calls
specs.numerator: reps with <3 outbound Logged Calls on each of 2 consecutive eligible days
specs.event_sequence: per-rep per-day outbound Logged Call count over consecutive days
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: survivorship: a rep who logged nothing is invisible
specs.hold_reason: rep population + eligible-workday/absence handling not provable without an accepted roster (CAGE is quarantined; Users is a candidate-unproved route). Comm-log-only reps under-count the worst offenders.

specs.title: Rep's outbound text-to-call ratio exceeds 5:1 (avoiding voice)
specs.population: reps with >=5 outbound Sales comms this week at this rooftop
specs.numerator: eligible reps whose outbound Text:Logged-Call ratio > 5:1 (0 calls with >=1 text = total voice avoidance)
specs.event_sequence: per-rep count of outbound Text vs outbound Logged Call; flag if calls==0&texts>0 OR texts>5*calls
specs.zero_denominator: unresolved when no rep reaches the >=5 outbound floor
specs.minimum_sample: >=5 outbound per rep (labeled operational floor, anti-noise)
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: outbound-only scope; a rep below the floor is not judged; does not distinguish deliberate avoidance from customer channel preference; cross-rooftop shared staff counted only for their activity at this rooftop

specs.title: Rep never uses video/personalized media while peers do
specs.numerator: reps with zero video while peers use video
specs.event_sequence: per-rep has_video presence vs peer video usage
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.hold_reason: "never" needs multi-week history; a single week only shows "no video this week" and would misclassify biweekly/occasional video users. Insufficient history.

specs.title: Response latency grows across a thread (fade-out)
specs.numerator: threads with monotonically growing rep response latency
specs.event_sequence: ordered rep response gaps within a thread; test monotonic growth
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.hold_reason: requires business-hours-adjusted latency + a ratified "grows" definition + thread censoring handling; distinct from SW-134. Material semantic choices unresolved.

specs.title: BDC connect rate falls below 35%
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.hold_reason: native source (CAGE/Enterprise Performance) is quarantined; user_group is BDC/Internet combined (not pure BDC); interaction_result is ~61% blank and mixes channels, so the connect numerator / attempt denominator are not derivable.

specs.title: Voicemails left without follow-up text/email within 15 minutes
specs.numerator: voicemails with no same-thread follow-up text/email within 15 min
specs.event_sequence: reached-voicemail then follow-up channel within 15 min
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: Answering Machine = reached voicemail, not proof a message was left
specs.hold_reason: "voicemail left" is unprovable: interaction_result "Answering Machine" only proves an outbound call reached a voicemail system, not that a message was left. Material meaning change (a proxy, not the literal condition).

specs.title: Customer's last message unanswered >4 business hours during active thread
specs.population: active threads with an unanswered inbound customer message
specs.numerator: inbound customer messages unanswered >4 business hours
specs.event_sequence: inbound customer message with no subsequent rep reply within 4 business hours
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: external Sales hours captured 2026-09-01 (serra280.com / tonyserraford.com: Mon-Sat 9:00-19:00, Sun closed, America/New_York) but "active thread" + right-censoring + as-of reference remain unratified
specs.hold_reason: needs a ratified "active thread" definition + right-censoring (late-week inbound messages have not had 4 business hours to be answered by capture) + an as-of reference. These choices materially move the count (fail closed under truth-over-compliance).

specs.title: Rep replies after customer sent 2+ consecutive messages (customer chasing rep)
specs.numerator: threads containing a run of >=2 consecutive inbound customer messages immediately followed by an outbound rep message
specs.event_sequence: for each outbound reply at minute o, count inbound at a minute strictly in (rep’s previous outbound minute, o); >=2 flags the thread (timestamp-value rule; invariant to same-minute tie order)
specs.zero_denominator: unresolved when no thread has >=2 messages
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: minute-resolution timestamps: the rule is a function of the (direction, minute) multiset only, so it is invariant to same-minute ordering (an arbitrary tie-break would swing the count materially); an inbound sharing the reply minute is conservatively excluded and disclosed (ambiguous_excluded_endpoints); conservative/right-truncated at the window edge (under-counts, never over-counts); does not assert customer dissatisfaction

specs.title: Response gap widens across a thread (2h -> 8h -> 24h)
specs.event_sequence: three consecutive escalating rep response gaps
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: needs >=3 rep-response cycles per thread in one week (history-limited)
specs.hold_reason: requires >=3 rep-response cycles per thread within one week (history-limited) and a ratified wall-clock vs business-hours basis. Material.

specs.title: Rep replies to text with email (channel mismatch)
specs.numerator: threads with an inbound Text immediately followed by an outbound Email (same thread)
specs.event_sequence: distinct minute buckets: a SINGLETON inbound-Text bucket immediately followed by a SINGLETON outbound-Email bucket (next distinct bucket). Non-singleton endpoint buckets leave within-minute order unknowable and are EXCLUDED from the numerator + disclosed; eligibility/count never depend on same-minute order
specs.threshold: channel mismatch (literal): inbound Text answered by outbound Email
specs.zero_denominator: unresolved when no thread has >=2 messages
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: every observed candidate had an ambiguous same-minute endpoint bucket; the numerator would depend on unknowable within-minute order, so no unambiguous event survives
specs.hold_reason: under the conservative unique-minute-bucket adjacency, every observed inbound-Text->outbound-Email candidate has a non-singleton endpoint bucket (Honda 1, Nissan 1, Ford 0 candidate events, all ambiguous). The earlier 1/1/0 depended on unknowable within-minute ordering; reporting 0 would fabricate "missing" as zero. Under all-three-rooftops-or-no-metric, held across all three.
specs.held_next_action: acquire a higher-resolution timestamp (seconds) or an unambiguous message-sequence source so inbound-Text->outbound-Email adjacency can be established without same-minute ambiguity; then re-evaluate all three rooftops.

specs.title: Multiple rapid-fire rep messages with no customer reply (spammy cadence)
specs.numerator: threads with >=K rapid-fire outbound messages and no inbound between
specs.event_sequence: run of >=K consecutive outbound within T minutes, no inbound between
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: the proxy parameters swing the result ~3x (>=3-in-60min flags ~33% of threads = normal multi-touch cadence)
specs.hold_reason: authorized only as a labeled operational proxy, but "multiple"/"rapid-fire" (K count, T window) are unratified and materially change the flag population. No proxy substitution permitted here — held for ratification.

specs.title: Cadence health composite (response times, message balance, thread momentum)
specs.baseline_basis: internal operational target (red-flag rate ideal = 0); NOT an industry benchmark
specs.limitations: depends on unresolved response-time + momentum components
specs.hold_reason: composite over components that are themselves unresolved (SW-076/SW-134 held; momentum needs history). A composite cannot hide unresolved components.
